metadata.title: Print Accountability

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for attributing printing activity to responsible identities and supporting investigation, escalation, and remediation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Print audit logs, incident workflows, usage reporting systems, and accountability tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing accountability, attribution, and investigation capability for institutional printing services.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Print accountability assumes baseline identity attribution and print event logging.

metadata.remarks: Print Accountability defines trust properties required to investigate misuse, disputes, or incidents involving printed material. This pattern focuses on attribution, evidentiary integrity, and governance response, and does not address secure release or data classification.

components.title: Print Event Attribution
components.description: Associates print actions with accountable identities and devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading to obscure responsibility for printed output.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to avoid accountability for misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for action attribution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print events are attributable to authenticated users.
Identity attributes support accurate attribution of printing actions.

components.title: Print Activity Audit Trail
components.description: Maintains an immutable and reviewable log of print-related events.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to printing activity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to preserve evidentiary integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printing events are defined and logged as auditable activities.
Audit records are generated for printing actions.

components.title: Print Incident Investigation Support
components.description: Supports investigation and response to printing-related incidents or disputes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or corruption of print-related records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and response to suspicious activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printing-related incidents are analyzed and investigated.
Audit review supports escalation and response.

components.title: Print Accountability Governance
components.description: Aligns printing accountability with institutional governance and disciplinary processes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper expansion or abuse of privileges to avoid oversight.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to ensure appropriate consequences for misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define acceptable use and consequences for printing misuse.
